/-- Unsigned branch refinement on `x ≤ c`. -/
theorem range_refine_ule {w : Nat} {lo hi x c : BitVec w}
    (hlo : lo ≤ x) (hhi : x ≤ hi) (hc : x ≤ c) :
    lo ≤ x ∧ x ≤ bvMin hi c :=
  ⟨hlo, le_bvMin hhi hc⟩

/-- Unsigned branch refinement on `c ≤ x`. -/
theorem range_refine_uge {w : Nat} {lo hi x c : BitVec w}
    (hlo : lo ≤ x) (hhi : x ≤ hi) (hc : c ≤ x) :
    bvMax lo c ≤ x ∧ x ≤ hi :=
  ⟨bvMax_le hlo hc, hhi⟩

/-- Unsigned branch refinement on strict `x < c`. -/
theorem range_refine_ult {w : Nat} {lo hi x c : BitVec w}
    (hlo : lo ≤ x) (hhi : x ≤ hi) (hc : x < c) :
    lo ≤ x ∧ x ≤ bvMin hi (c - BitVec.ofNat w 1) := by
  cases w with
  | zero =>
    have hx0 : x.toNat = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.le_of_lt_succ x.isLt)
    have hc0 : c.toNat = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.le_of_lt_succ c.isLt)
    have hlt : x.toNat < c.toNat := hc
    rw [hx0, hc0] at hlt
    exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero 0 hlt)
  | succ w' =>
    have h1lt : 1 < Nat.pow 2 (w' + 1) := by
      rw [nat_pow_succ, Nat.mul_two]
      exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_self 1)
        (Nat.add_le_add (nat_two_pow_pos w') (nat_two_pow_pos w'))
    have h1le : BitVec.ofNat (w' + 1) 1 ≤ c := by
      change (BitVec.ofNat (w' + 1) 1).toNat ≤ c.toNat
      rw [Anneal.BitVec.toNat_ofNat, nat_mod_eq_of_lt h1lt]
      exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le x.toNat) hc
    have hxc : x ≤ c - BitVec.ofNat (w' + 1) 1 := by
      change x.toNat ≤ (c - BitVec.ofNat (w' + 1) 1).toNat
      rw [Anneal.BitVec.toNat_sub_of_le h1le, Anneal.BitVec.toNat_ofNat,
        nat_mod_eq_of_lt h1lt]
      exact Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt hc
    exact ⟨hlo, le_bvMin hhi hxc⟩

/-- Unsigned branch refinement on strict `c < x`. -/
theorem range_refine_ugt {w : Nat} {lo hi x c : BitVec w}
    (hlo : lo ≤ x) (hhi : x ≤ hi) (hc : c < x) :
    bvMax lo (c + BitVec.ofNat w 1) ≤ x ∧ x ≤ hi := by
  cases w with
  | zero =>
    have hx0 : x.toNat = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.le_of_lt_succ x.isLt)
    have hc0 : c.toNat = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.le_of_lt_succ c.isLt)
    have hlt : c.toNat < x.toNat := hc
    rw [hx0, hc0] at hlt
    exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero 0 hlt)
  | succ w' =>
    have h1lt : 1 < Nat.pow 2 (w' + 1) := by
      rw [nat_pow_succ, Nat.mul_two]
      exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_self 1)
        (Nat.add_le_add (nat_two_pow_pos w') (nat_two_pow_pos w'))
    have hc1_le : c.toNat + 1 ≤ x.toNat := hc
    have hc1_lt : c.toNat + 1 < Nat.pow 2 (w' + 1) :=
      Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hc1_le x.isLt
    have hcx : c + BitVec.ofNat (w' + 1) 1 ≤ x := by
      change (c + BitVec.ofNat (w' + 1) 1).toNat ≤ x.toNat
      rw [Anneal.BitVec.toNat_add, Anneal.BitVec.toNat_ofNat,
        nat_mod_eq_of_lt h1lt, nat_mod_eq_of_lt hc1_lt]
      exact hc1_le
    exact ⟨bvMax_le hlo hcx, hhi⟩

/-- Signed interval intersection soundness. -/
theorem signed_range_intersect_sound {w : Nat} {lo₁ hi₁ lo₂ hi₂ x : BitVec w}
    (h1 : sle lo₁ x ∧ sle x hi₁) (h2 : sle lo₂ x ∧ sle x hi₂) :
    sle (sbvMax lo₁ lo₂) x ∧ sle x (sbvMin hi₁ hi₂) :=
  ⟨sbvMax_sle h1.1 h2.1, sle_sbvMin h1.2 h2.2⟩

/-- Signed branch refinement on `sle x c`. -/
theorem signed_range_refine_sle {w : Nat} {lo hi x c : BitVec w}
    (hlo : sle lo x) (hhi : sle x hi) (hc : sle x c) :
    sle lo x ∧ sle x (sbvMin hi c) :=
  ⟨hlo, sle_sbvMin hhi hc⟩

/-- Signed branch refinement on `sle c x`. -/
theorem signed_range_refine_sge {w : Nat} {lo hi x c : BitVec w}
    (hlo : sle lo x) (hhi : sle x hi) (hc : sle c x) :
    sle (sbvMax lo c) x ∧ sle x hi :=
  ⟨sbvMax_sle hlo hc, hhi⟩

private theorem signedKey_sub_one {w : Nat} (hw : 0 < w) {c : BitVec w}
    (hpos : 0 < signedKey c) :
    signedKey (c - BitVec.ofNat w 1) = signedKey c - 1 := by
  have h1lt : 1 < Nat.pow 2 w := by
    rw [nat_two_pow_split hw]
    exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_self 1)
      (Nat.add_le_add (nat_two_pow_pos (w - 1)) (nat_two_pow_pos (w - 1)))
  have hmod_c :
      Nat.mod ((c - BitVec.ofNat w 1).toNat + Nat.pow 2 (w - 1)) (Nat.pow 2 w) =
        Nat.mod ((signedKey c - 1) + Nat.pow 2 w) (Nat.pow 2 w) := by
    rw [Anneal.BitVec.toNat_sub, Anneal.BitVec.toNat_ofNat,
      nat_mod_eq_of_lt h1lt, nat_add_mod_cancel_left]
    have hkey := signedKey_eq_mod_add_half hw c
    have hrearr :
        (Nat.pow 2 w - 1) + c.toNat + Nat.pow 2 (w - 1) =
          (Nat.pow 2 w - 1) + (c.toNat + Nat.pow 2 (w - 1)) :=
      Nat.add_assoc _ _ _
    rw [hrearr, ← nat_add_mod_cancel_right (Nat.pow 2 w - 1) _ (Nat.pow 2 w),
      ← hkey]
    have hstep :
        (Nat.pow 2 w - 1) + signedKey c = (signedKey c - 1) + Nat.pow 2 w := by
      have hsc : signedKey c = 1 + (signedKey c - 1) := by
        rw [Nat.add_comm 1 (signedKey c - 1)]
        exact Eq.symm (Nat.sub_add_cancel hpos)
      have h1 := congrArg (fun z => (Nat.pow 2 w - 1) + z) hsc
      rw [← Nat.add_assoc (Nat.pow 2 w - 1) 1 (signedKey c - 1),
        Nat.sub_add_cancel (nat_two_pow_pos w),
        Nat.add_comm (Nat.pow 2 w) (signedKey c - 1)] at h1
      exact h1
    rw [hstep]
  rw [signedKey_eq_mod_add_half hw (c - BitVec.ofNat w 1), hmod_c,
    Nat.add_comm (signedKey c - 1) (Nat.pow 2 w), nat_add_mod_left]
  exact nat_mod_eq_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le _ 1) (signedKey_lt c))

private theorem signedKey_add_one {w : Nat} (hw : 0 < w) {c : BitVec w}
    (hlt : signedKey c + 1 < Nat.pow 2 w) :
    signedKey (c + BitVec.ofNat w 1) = signedKey c + 1 := by
  have h1lt : 1 < Nat.pow 2 w := by
    rw [nat_two_pow_split hw]
    exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_self 1)
      (Nat.add_le_add (nat_two_pow_pos (w - 1)) (nat_two_pow_pos (w - 1)))
  rw [signedKey_eq_mod_add_half hw (c + BitVec.ofNat w 1),
    Anneal.BitVec.toNat_add, Anneal.BitVec.toNat_ofNat,
    nat_mod_eq_of_lt h1lt, nat_add_mod_cancel_left]
  have hrearr :
      c.toNat + 1 + Nat.pow 2 (w - 1) = (c.toNat + Nat.pow 2 (w - 1)) + 1 :=
    Nat.add_right_comm c.toNat 1 (Nat.pow 2 (w - 1))
  rw [hrearr, ← nat_add_mod_cancel_left (c.toNat + Nat.pow 2 (w - 1)) 1 (Nat.pow 2 w),
    ← signedKey_eq_mod_add_half hw c]
  exact nat_mod_eq_of_lt hlt

/-- Signed branch refinement on strict `slt x c`. -/
theorem signed_range_refine_slt {w : Nat} {lo hi x c : BitVec w}
    (hlo : sle lo x) (hhi : sle x hi) (hc : slt x c) :
    sle lo x ∧ sle x (sbvMin hi (c - BitVec.ofNat w 1)) := by
  cases w with
  | zero =>
    have hx0 : signedKey x = 0 :=
      Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (signedKey_lt x))
    have hc0 : signedKey c = 0 :=
      Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (signedKey_lt c))
    have hlt : signedKey x < signedKey c := hc
    rw [hx0, hc0] at hlt
    exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero 0 hlt)
  | succ w' =>
    have hw : 0 < w' + 1 := Nat.zero_lt_succ w'
    have hc_pos : 0 < signedKey c := Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) hc
    have hxc : sle x (c - BitVec.ofNat (w' + 1) 1) := by
      unfold sle
      rw [signedKey_sub_one hw hc_pos]
      exact Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt hc
    exact ⟨hlo, sle_sbvMin hhi hxc⟩

/-- Signed branch refinement on strict `slt c x`. -/
theorem signed_range_refine_sgt {w : Nat} {lo hi x c : BitVec w}
    (hlo : sle lo x) (hhi : sle x hi) (hc : slt c x) :
    sle (sbvMax lo (c + BitVec.ofNat w 1)) x ∧ sle x hi := by
  cases w with
  | zero =>
    have hx0 : signedKey x = 0 :=
      Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (signedKey_lt x))
    have hc0 : signedKey c = 0 :=
      Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (signedKey_lt c))
    have hlt : signedKey c < signedKey x := hc
    rw [hx0, hc0] at hlt
    exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero 0 hlt)
  | succ w' =>
    have hw : 0 < w' + 1 := Nat.zero_lt_succ w'
    have hc1_le : signedKey c + 1 ≤ signedKey x := hc
    have hc1_lt : signedKey c + 1 < Nat.pow 2 (w' + 1) :=
      Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hc1_le (signedKey_lt x)
    have hcx : sle (c + BitVec.ofNat (w' + 1) 1) x := by
      unfold sle
      rw [signedKey_add_one hw hc1_lt]
      exact hc1_le
    exact ⟨sbvMax_sle hlo hcx, hhi⟩

/-! ## Part 4: Bitfield Extraction and Byte-Swap (`bswap16`/`32`/`64`) -/

/-- Extract a `len`-bit field starting at bit offset `lo` from `x : BitVec w`.
-/
@[expose] def extractBits {w : Nat} (x : BitVec w) (lo len : Nat) : BitVec len :=
  Anneal.BitVec.setWidth len (Anneal.BitVec.ushr x lo)

/-- Exact `getLsbD` characterization of `extractBits x lo len`. -/
@[simp] theorem getLsbD_extractBits {w : Nat} (x : BitVec w)
    (lo len i : Nat) :
    Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD (extractBits x lo len) i =
      (decide (i < len) && Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD x (i + lo)) := by
  unfold extractBits
  rw [Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth, Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_ushr]

/-- Exact `testBit` characterization of `extractBits x lo len`. -/
theorem testBit_extractBits {w : Nat} (x : BitVec w) (lo len i : Nat) :
    (extractBits x lo len).toNat.testBit i =
      (decide (i < len) && x.toNat.testBit (i + lo)) :=
  getLsbD_extractBits x lo len i

/-- Extracting a zero-width bitfield always yields `0#0`. -/
@[simp] theorem extractBits_zero_width {w : Nat} (x : BitVec w) (lo : Nat) :
    extractBits x lo 0 = BitVec.ofNat 0 0 := by
  apply Anneal.BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq
  intro i hi
  exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero i hi)

/-- `extractBits` distributes over bitwise OR. -/
theorem extractBits_or {w : Nat} (x y : BitVec w) (lo len : Nat) :
    extractBits (Anneal.BitVec.or x y) lo len =
      Anneal.BitVec.or (extractBits x lo len) (extractBits y lo len) := by
  apply Anneal.BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq
  intro i hi
  rw [getLsbD_extractBits, Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_or,
    Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_or, getLsbD_extractBits, getLsbD_extractBits,
    decide_eq_true hi, Bool.true_and, Bool.true_and, Bool.true_and]

/-- Extracting a field placed at bit offset `lo` (`lo + len ≤ w`) recovers
the original field exactly. -/
theorem extractBits_shl_setWidth {w len : Nat} (a : BitVec len) {lo : Nat}
    (hfit : lo + len ≤ w) :
    extractBits (Anneal.BitVec.shl (Anneal.BitVec.setWidth w a) lo) lo len =
      a := by
  apply Anneal.BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq
  intro i hi
  have hilo_lt : i + lo < w := by
    rw [Nat.add_comm i lo]
    exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.add_lt_add_left hi lo) hfit
  rw [getLsbD_extractBits, decide_eq_true hi, Bool.true_and,
    Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_shl, decide_eq_true hilo_lt, Bool.true_and,
    decide_eq_true (Nat.le_add_left lo i), Bool.true_and,
    Nat.add_sub_cancel, Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth,
    decide_eq_true (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hi (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_left len lo) hfit)),
    Bool.true_and]

private theorem extractBits_shl_setWidth_disjoint {w len₁ len₂ : Nat}
    (b : BitVec len₂) {lo₁ lo₂ : Nat}
    (hdisj : lo₁ + len₁ ≤ lo₂ ∨ lo₂ + len₂ ≤ lo₁) :
    extractBits (Anneal.BitVec.shl (Anneal.BitVec.setWidth w b) lo₂) lo₁ len₁ =
      BitVec.ofNat len₁ 0 := by
  apply Anneal.BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq
  intro i hi
  rw [getLsbD_extractBits, decide_eq_true hi, Bool.true_and,
    Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_shl, Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_zero]
  cases hdisj with
  | inl hleft =>
    have hlt : i + lo₁ < lo₂ := by
      rw [Nat.add_comm i lo₁]
      exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.add_lt_add_left hi lo₁) hleft
    rw [decide_eq_false (Nat.not_le_of_gt hlt), Bool.false_and, Bool.and_false]
  | inr hright =>
    have hge : len₂ ≤ i + lo₁ - lo₂ := by
      have h1 : lo₂ + len₂ ≤ i + lo₁ :=
        Nat.le_trans hright (Nat.le_add_left lo₁ i)
      have h2 : len₂ + lo₂ ≤ (i + lo₁ - lo₂) + lo₂ := by
        rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_right lo₂ len₂) h1),
          Nat.add_comm len₂ lo₂]
        exact h1
      exact Nat.le_of_add_le_add_right h2
    rw [Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth, Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_ge b hge,
      Bool.and_false, Bool.and_false, Bool.and_false]

/-- Extracting two non-overlapping bitfields packed with bitwise OR recovers
both fields cleanly. -/
theorem extractBits_or_disjoint {w len₁ len₂ : Nat}
    (a : BitVec len₁) (b : BitVec len₂) {lo₁ lo₂ : Nat}
    (hfit₁ : lo₁ + len₁ ≤ w) (hfit₂ : lo₂ + len₂ ≤ w)
    (hdisj : lo₁ + len₁ ≤ lo₂ ∨ lo₂ + len₂ ≤ lo₁) :
    let packed := Anneal.BitVec.or
      (Anneal.BitVec.shl (Anneal.BitVec.setWidth w a) lo₁)
      (Anneal.BitVec.shl (Anneal.BitVec.setWidth w b) lo₂)
    extractBits packed lo₁ len₁ = a ∧ extractBits packed lo₂ len₂ = b := by
  dsimp only
  constructor
  · rw [extractBits_or, extractBits_shl_setWidth a hfit₁,
      extractBits_shl_setWidth_disjoint b hdisj, Anneal.BitVec.or_zero]
  · rw [extractBits_or, extractBits_shl_setWidth_disjoint a (Or.symm hdisj),
      extractBits_shl_setWidth b hfit₂, Anneal.BitVec.zero_or]

/-- Exact soundness of tnum bitfield extraction (`extractBits`). -/
theorem tnum_extractBits_sound {w : Nat} {m x val : BitVec w}
    (lo len : Nat) (h : Anneal.BitVec.MaskEq m x val) :
    Anneal.BitVec.MaskEq (extractBits m lo len) (extractBits x lo len)
      (extractBits val lo len) :=
  tnum_setWidth_sound len (Anneal.BitVec.tnum_ushr_sound lo h)

/-- Move byte `src` (bits `8 * src .. 8 * src + 7`) of `x` into byte position
`dst` (bits `8 * dst .. 8 * dst + 7`). -/
@[expose] def moveByte {w : Nat} (x : BitVec w) (src dst : Nat) : BitVec w :=
  Anneal.BitVec.shl
    (Anneal.BitVec.setWidth w (extractBits x (8 * src) 8))
    (8 * dst)

private theorem getLsbD_moveByte {w : Nat} (x : BitVec w) (src dst i : Nat)
    (hi : i < w) :
    Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD (moveByte x src dst) i =
      (decide (Nat.div i 8 = dst) &&
        Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD x (Nat.mod i 8 + 8 * src)) := by
  unfold moveByte
  rw [Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_shl, decide_eq_true hi, Bool.true_and,
    Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth, getLsbD_extractBits]
  have h8pos : 0 < 8 := by decide
  cases Nat.lt_or_ge (Nat.div i 8) dst with
  | inl hlt =>
    have hne : ¬ (Nat.div i 8 = dst) := Nat.ne_of_lt hlt
    have hi_lt : i < 8 * dst := by
      rw [Nat.mul_comm 8 dst]
      exact (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul h8pos).1 hlt
    rw [decide_eq_false hne, decide_eq_false (Nat.not_le_of_gt hi_lt),
      Bool.false_and, Bool.false_and]
  | inr hge =>
    cases Nat.lt_or_ge dst (Nat.div i 8) with
    | inl hgt =>
      have hne : ¬ (Nat.div i 8 = dst) := Nat.ne_of_gt hgt
      have hdst1_le : dst + 1 ≤ Nat.div i 8 := hgt
      have hmul_le : 8 * dst + 8 ≤ i := by
        have h1 : (dst + 1) * 8 ≤ i := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le h8pos).1 hdst1_le
        rw [Nat.succ_mul, Nat.mul_comm dst 8] at h1
        exact h1
      have hsub_ge : 8 ≤ i - 8 * dst := by
        have h1 : 8 + 8 * dst ≤ (i - 8 * dst) + 8 * dst := by
          rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_right (8 * dst) 8) hmul_le),
            Nat.add_comm 8 (8 * dst)]
          exact hmul_le
        exact Nat.le_of_add_le_add_right h1
      rw [decide_eq_false hne, Bool.false_and,
        decide_eq_false (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hsub_ge),
        Bool.false_and, Bool.and_false, Bool.and_false]
    | inr hle =>
      have heq : Nat.div i 8 = dst := Nat.le_antisymm hle hge
      have hi_decomp : 8 * dst + Nat.mod i 8 = i := by
        rw [← heq]
        exact nat_div_add_mod i 8
      have h8dst_le : 8 * dst ≤ i := by
        rw [← hi_decomp]
        exact Nat.le_add_right (8 * dst) (Nat.mod i 8)
      have hsub_eq : i - 8 * dst = Nat.mod i 8 := by
        have h1 := congrArg (fun z => z - 8 * dst) (Eq.symm hi_decomp)
        rw [Nat.add_comm (8 * dst) (Nat.mod i 8), Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h1
        exact h1
      have hmod_lt : Nat.mod i 8 < 8 := nat_mod_lt i h8pos
      have hmod_lt_w : Nat.mod i 8 < w :=
        Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.mod_le i 8) hi
      rw [decide_eq_true heq, Bool.true_and, decide_eq_true h8dst_le,
        Bool.true_and, hsub_eq, decide_eq_true hmod_lt_w, Bool.true_and,
        decide_eq_true hmod_lt, Bool.true_and]

/-- Build the low `k` destination bytes of byte-reversed `x : BitVec (8 * n)`
via structural `@Nat.rec`. -/
@[expose] def bswapBytesAux {n : Nat} (x : BitVec (8 * n)) (k : Nat) : BitVec (8 * n) :=
  @Nat.rec (fun _ => BitVec (8 * n))
    (BitVec.ofNat (8 * n) 0)
    (fun j acc => Anneal.BitVec.or acc (moveByte x (n - 1 - j) j))
    k

private theorem bswapBytesAux_succ {n : Nat} (x : BitVec (8 * n)) (k : Nat) :
    bswapBytesAux x (k + 1) =
      Anneal.BitVec.or (bswapBytesAux x k) (moveByte x (n - 1 - k) k) :=
  rfl

private theorem getLsbD_bswapBytesAux {n : Nat} (x : BitVec (8 * n)) (k : Nat) :
    ∀ i, i < 8 * n →
      Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD (bswapBytesAux x k) i =
        (decide (Nat.div i 8 < k) &&
          Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD x (Nat.mod i 8 + 8 * (n - 1 - Nat.div i 8))) := by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro i _
    change Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD (BitVec.ofNat (8 * n) 0) i = _
    rw [Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_zero, decide_eq_false (Nat.not_lt_zero _),
      Bool.false_and]
  | succ k ih =>
    intro i hi
    rw [bswapBytesAux_succ, Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_or, ih i hi,
      getLsbD_moveByte x (n - 1 - k) k i hi]
    cases Nat.lt_or_ge (Nat.div i 8) k with
    | inl hlt =>
      rw [decide_eq_true hlt, decide_eq_true (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hlt),
        decide_eq_false (Nat.ne_of_lt hlt), Bool.true_and,
        Bool.false_and, Bool.or_false]
    | inr hge =>
      cases Nat.lt_or_ge k (Nat.div i 8) with
      | inl hgt =>
        rw [decide_eq_false (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hge),
          decide_eq_false (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hgt),
          decide_eq_false (Nat.ne_of_gt hgt), Bool.false_and, Bool.false_and,
          Bool.false_or]
      | inr hle =>
        have heq : Nat.div i 8 = k := Nat.le_antisymm hle hge
        rw [heq, decide_eq_false (Nat.lt_irrefl k),
          decide_eq_true (Nat.lt_succ_self k), decide_eq_true rfl,
          Bool.false_and, Bool.true_and, Bool.false_or]

/-- Reverse the `n` bytes of a `(8 * n)`-bit bitvector. -/
@[expose] def bswapBytes (n : Nat) (x : BitVec (8 * n)) : BitVec (8 * n) :=
  bswapBytesAux x n

/-- Exact `getLsbD` characterization of `bswapBytes n x`. -/
@[simp] theorem getLsbD_bswapBytes (n : Nat) (x : BitVec (8 * n)) (i : Nat) :
    Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD (bswapBytes n x) i =
      (decide (i < 8 * n) &&
        Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD x (Nat.mod i 8 + 8 * (n - 1 - Nat.div i 8))) := by
  cases Nat.lt_or_ge i (8 * n) with
  | inr hge =>
    rw [Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_ge _ hge,
      decide_eq_false (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hge), Bool.false_and]
  | inl hlt =>
    have hdiv_lt : Nat.div i 8 < n := by
      rw [nat_div_lt_iff_lt_mul (by decide : 0 < 8), Nat.mul_comm n 8]
      exact hlt
    unfold bswapBytes
    rw [getLsbD_bswapBytesAux x n i hlt, decide_eq_true hdiv_lt,
      decide_eq_true hlt, Bool.true_and]

/-- Byte reversal is an involution for every byte count `n`. -/
@[simp] theorem bswapBytes_bswapBytes (n : Nat) (x : BitVec (8 * n)) :
    bswapBytes n (bswapBytes n x) = x := by
  apply Anneal.BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq
  intro i hi
  have h8pos : 0 < 8 := by decide
  have hdiv_lt : Nat.div i 8 < n := by
    rw [nat_div_lt_iff_lt_mul h8pos, Nat.mul_comm n 8]
    exact hi
  have hdiv_le : Nat.div i 8 ≤ n - 1 := Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt hdiv_lt
  have hrev_lt : n - 1 - Nat.div i 8 < n :=
    Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le (n - 1) (Nat.div i 8))
      (Nat.sub_lt (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) hdiv_lt) Nat.one_pos)
  let j := Nat.mod i 8 + 8 * (n - 1 - Nat.div i 8)
  have hj_lt : j < 8 * n := by
    have hmod_lt : Nat.mod i 8 < 8 := nat_mod_lt i h8pos
    have h1 : j < 8 + 8 * (n - 1 - Nat.div i 8) :=
      Nat.add_lt_add_right hmod_lt _
    have h2 : 8 + 8 * (n - 1 - Nat.div i 8) =
        8 * ((n - 1 - Nat.div i 8) + 1) := by
      rw [Nat.mul_succ, Nat.add_comm]
    have h3 : 8 * ((n - 1 - Nat.div i 8) + 1) ≤ 8 * n :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left 8 hrev_lt
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le h1 h3
  have hj_div : Nat.div j 8 = n - 1 - Nat.div i 8 := by
    unfold j
    rw [nat_add_mul_div_left _ _ h8pos,
      nat_div_eq_of_lt (nat_mod_lt i h8pos), Nat.zero_add]
  have hj_mod : Nat.mod j 8 = Nat.mod i 8 := by
    unfold j
    rw [nat_add_mul_mod_self_left, nat_mod_eq_of_lt (nat_mod_lt i h8pos)]
  have hj_back : Nat.mod j 8 + 8 * (n - 1 - Nat.div j 8) = i := by
    rw [hj_mod, hj_div, nat_sub_sub_self hdiv_le, Nat.add_comm]
    exact nat_div_add_mod i 8
  rw [getLsbD_bswapBytes, decide_eq_true hi, Bool.true_and,
    getLsbD_bswapBytes, decide_eq_true hj_lt, Bool.true_and, hj_back]

/-- Byte reversal is injective for every byte count `n`. -/
theorem bswapBytes_injective {n : Nat} {x y : BitVec (8 * n)}
    (h : bswapBytes n x = bswapBytes n y) : x = y := by
  rw [← bswapBytes_bswapBytes n x, ← bswapBytes_bswapBytes n y, h]

/-- Exact soundness of tnum byte reversal (`bswapBytes`). -/
theorem tnum_bswapBytes_sound (n : Nat) {m x val : BitVec (8 * n)}
    (h : Anneal.BitVec.MaskEq m x val) :
    Anneal.BitVec.MaskEq (bswapBytes n m) (bswapBytes n x)
      (bswapBytes n val) := by
  rw [Anneal.BitVec.maskEq_iff_getLsbD]
  intro i hi hm
  have h8pos : 0 < 8 := by decide
  have hdiv_lt : Nat.div i 8 < n := by
    rw [nat_div_lt_iff_lt_mul h8pos, Nat.mul_comm n 8]
    exact hi
  have hrev_lt : n - 1 - Nat.div i 8 < n :=
    Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le (n - 1) (Nat.div i 8))
      (Nat.sub_lt (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) hdiv_lt) Nat.one_pos)
  have hj_lt : Nat.mod i 8 + 8 * (n - 1 - Nat.div i 8) < 8 * n := by
    have h1 : Nat.mod i 8 + 8 * (n - 1 - Nat.div i 8) <
        8 + 8 * (n - 1 - Nat.div i 8) :=
      Nat.add_lt_add_right (nat_mod_lt i h8pos) _
    have h2 : 8 + 8 * (n - 1 - Nat.div i 8) =
        8 * ((n - 1 - Nat.div i 8) + 1) := by
      rw [Nat.mul_succ, Nat.add_comm]
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le h1 (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 8 hrev_lt)
  rw [getLsbD_bswapBytes, decide_eq_true hi, Bool.true_and] at hm
  rw [getLsbD_bswapBytes, getLsbD_bswapBytes, decide_eq_true hi,
    Bool.true_and]
  exact Anneal.BitVec.maskEq_iff_getLsbD.1 h _ hj_lt hm

/-- 16-bit byte swap (`u16::swap_bytes`). -/
@[expose] def bswap16 (x : BitVec 16) : BitVec 16 :=
  bswapBytes 2 x

/-- 32-bit byte swap (`u32::swap_bytes`). -/
@[expose] def bswap32 (x : BitVec 32) : BitVec 32 :=
  bswapBytes 4 x

/-- 64-bit byte swap (`u64::swap_bytes`). -/
@[expose] def bswap64 (x : BitVec 64) : BitVec 64 :=
  bswapBytes 8 x

/-- `bswap16` is an involution (`bswap16 (bswap16 x) = x`). -/
@[simp] theorem bswap16_bswap16 (x : BitVec 16) :
    bswap16 (bswap16 x) = x :=
  bswapBytes_bswapBytes 2 x

/-- `bswap32` is an involution (`bswap32 (bswap32 x) = x`). -/
@[simp] theorem bswap32_bswap32 (x : BitVec 32) :
    bswap32 (bswap32 x) = x :=
  bswapBytes_bswapBytes 4 x

/-- `bswap64` is an involution (`bswap64 (bswap64 x) = x`). -/
@[simp] theorem bswap64_bswap64 (x : BitVec 64) :
    bswap64 (bswap64 x) = x :=
  bswapBytes_bswapBytes 8 x

/-- `bswap16` is injective. -/
theorem bswap16_injective {x y : BitVec 16} (h : bswap16 x = bswap16 y) :
    x = y :=
  bswapBytes_injective h

/-- `bswap32` is injective. -/
theorem bswap32_injective {x y : BitVec 32} (h : bswap32 x = bswap32 y) :
    x = y :=
  bswapBytes_injective h

/-- `bswap64` is injective. -/
theorem bswap64_injective {x y : BitVec 64} (h : bswap64 x = bswap64 y) :
    x = y :=
  bswapBytes_injective h

/-- Shift-and-OR characterization of `bswap16`:
`bswap16 x = (x >>> 8) ||| (x <<< 8)`. -/
theorem bswap16_eq_ushr_or_shl (x : BitVec 16) :
    bswap16 x =
      Anneal.BitVec.or (Anneal.BitVec.ushr x 8) (Anneal.BitVec.shl x 8) := by
  apply Anneal.BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq
  intro i hi
  unfold bswap16
  rw [getLsbD_bswapBytes, decide_eq_true hi, Bool.true_and,
    Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_or, Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_ushr,
    Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_shl, decide_eq_true hi, Bool.true_and]
  have h8pos : 0 < 8 := by decide
  cases Nat.lt_or_ge i 8 with
  | inl hlt =>
    rw [decide_eq_false (Nat.not_le_of_gt hlt), Bool.false_and, Bool.or_false,
      nat_div_eq_of_lt hlt, nat_mod_eq_of_lt hlt]
  | inr hge =>
    have hdiv1 : Nat.div i 8 = 1 := by
      have h1 : 1 ≤ Nat.div i 8 := by
        rw [nat_le_div_iff_mul_le h8pos, Nat.one_mul]
        exact hge
      have h2 : Nat.div i 8 < 2 := by
        rw [nat_div_lt_iff_lt_mul h8pos]
        exact hi
      exact Nat.le_antisymm (Nat.le_of_lt_succ h2) h1
    have hmod_eq : Nat.mod i 8 = i - 8 := by
      have hdecomp := nat_div_add_mod i 8
      rw [hdiv1, Nat.mul_one] at hdecomp
      have h1 := congrArg (fun z => z - 8) hdecomp
      rw [Nat.add_comm 8 (Nat.mod i 8), Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h1
      exact h1
    have hge16 : 16 ≤ i + 8 := Nat.add_le_add_right hge 8
    rw [decide_eq_true hge, Bool.true_and, Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_ge x hge16,
      Bool.false_or, hdiv1, hmod_eq]
    rfl

end Anneal.BitVecArith

/-!
# Foundation-Locked Classical Excluded Middle & Choice (`Anneal.ClassicalEm`)

Anneal's 51 locked `Init.*` foundation modules exclude `Init.Classical`, and
`TrustedBoundary.allowedTheoryTacticKinds` excludes `by_cases`. This module
derives Diaconescu's theorem (`prop_em : p ∨ ¬ p`), double-negation elimination
(`of_not_not`), proof by contradiction (`by_contra`), classical logical bridges
(`imp_iff_not_or`, `not_and_iff_or_not`), and existential witness selection
(`chooseExists` / `chooseExists_spec`) directly from `Init.Core` using only
`[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]` (`Quot.sound` via `funext`) and
allowed Pass-1 tactics (`0` `._unsafe_rec`).

Usage in Pass-1 proofs (replacing `by_cases h : P`):
```lean
cases prop_em P with
| inl h => ...
| inr h => ...
```
-/

namespace Anneal.ClassicalEm

/-! ## 1. Classical Choice and Excluded Middle -/

/-- Extracts a witness from `Nonempty (Subtype P)` using `Classical.choice`. -/
@[expose] noncomputable def chooseSub {α : Sort u} {P : α → Prop}
    (h : Nonempty (Subtype P)) : α :=
  (Classical.choice h).1

/-- Specification of `chooseSub`: the chosen witness satisfies `P`. -/
theorem chooseSub_spec {α : Sort u} {P : α → Prop}
    (h : Nonempty (Subtype P)) : P (chooseSub h) :=
  (Classical.choice h).2

private noncomputable def chooseBool (P : Bool → Prop)
    (h : Nonempty (Subtype P)) : Bool :=
  (Classical.choice h).1

private theorem chooseBool_spec (P : Bool → Prop)
    (h : Nonempty (Subtype P)) : P (chooseBool P h) :=
  (Classical.choice h).2

private theorem chooseBool_congr {P Q : Bool → Prop} (hPQ : P = Q)
    (hP : Nonempty (Subtype P)) (hQ : Nonempty (Subtype Q)) :
    chooseBool P hP = chooseBool Q hQ := by
  subst hPQ
  rfl

private theorem bool_eq_or_ne (a b : Bool) : a = b ∨ a ≠ b := by
  cases a with
  | false =>
    cases b with
    | false => exact Or.inl rfl
    | true => exact Or.inr (fun h => by nomatch h)
  | true =>
    cases b with
    | false => exact Or.inr (fun h => by nomatch h)
    | true => exact Or.inl rfl

/-- Diaconescu's theorem (`p ∨ ¬ p`) over `prelude` + `Init.Core` without
`Init.Classical`, replacing banned `by_cases` via `cases prop_em p`. -/
theorem prop_em (p : Prop) : p ∨ ¬ p := by
  let U (x : Bool) : Prop := x = true ∨ p
  let V (x : Bool) : Prop := x = false ∨ p
  have exU : Nonempty (Subtype U) := ⟨⟨true, Or.inl rfl⟩⟩
  have exV : Nonempty (Subtype V) := ⟨⟨false, Or.inl rfl⟩⟩
  have hu : U (chooseBool U exU) := chooseBool_spec U exU
  have hv : V (chooseBool V exV) := chooseBool_spec V exV
  cases bool_eq_or_ne (chooseBool U exU) (chooseBool V exV) with
  | inr hne =>
    refine Or.inr ?_
    intro hp
    have hUV : U = V := by
      funext x
      exact propext ⟨fun _ => Or.inr hp, fun _ => Or.inr hp⟩
    exact hne (chooseBool_congr hUV exU exV)
  | inl heq =>
    cases hu with
    | inr hp => exact Or.inl hp
    | inl hut =>
      cases hv with
      | inr hp => exact Or.inl hp
      | inl hvf =>
        rw [hut, hvf] at heq
        nomatch heq

/-- Classical double-negation elimination derived from `prop_em`. -/
theorem of_not_not {p : Prop} (hnn : ¬ ¬ p) : p := by
  cases prop_em p with
  | inl hp => exact hp
  | inr hnp => exact False.elim (hnn hnp)

/-- Classical proof by contradiction (`(¬ p → False) → p`). -/
theorem by_contra {p : Prop} (h : ¬ p → False) : p :=
  of_not_not h

/-- Classical equivalence between `p → q` and `¬ p ∨ q`. -/
theorem imp_iff_not_or (p q : Prop) : (p → q) ↔ (¬ p ∨ q) := by
  constructor
  · intro hpq
    cases prop_em p with
    | inl hp => exact Or.inr (hpq hp)
    | inr hnp => exact Or.inl hnp
  · intro h hp
    cases h with
    | inl hnp => exact False.elim (hnp hp)
    | inr hq => exact hq

/-- Classical De Morgan equivalence (`¬ (p ∧ q) ↔ (¬ p ∨ ¬ q)`). -/
theorem not_and_iff_or_not (p q : Prop) : ¬ (p ∧ q) ↔ (¬ p ∨ ¬ q) := by
  constructor
  · intro hna
    cases prop_em p with
    | inr hnp => exact Or.inl hnp
    | inl hp =>
      exact Or.inr (fun hq => hna ⟨hp, hq⟩)
  · intro hor hpq
    cases hor with
    | inl hnp => exact hnp hpq.1
    | inr hnq => exact hnq hpq.2

/-- Selects a witness from an existential proof using `Classical.choice`.

Uses a pure elimination term rather than a `by` block so Lean can export the
`@[expose]` body cleanly in `module` mode without stuck metavariables. -/
@[expose] noncomputable def chooseExists {α : Sort u} {P : α → Prop}
    (h : ∃ x : α, P x) : α :=
  chooseSub (Exists.elim h fun w hw => ⟨⟨w, hw⟩⟩)

/-- Specification of `chooseExists`: the selected witness satisfies `P`. -/
theorem chooseExists_spec {α : Sort u} {P : α → Prop}
    (h : ∃ x : α, P x) : P (chooseExists h) :=
  chooseSub_spec (Exists.elim h fun w hw => ⟨⟨w, hw⟩⟩)

/-! ## 2. Kernel-Checked Canaries -/

/-- Canary exercising `prop_em` on concrete propositions `True` and `False`. -/
theorem canary_prop_em_concrete : (True ∨ ¬ True) ∧ (False ∨ ¬ False) :=
  ⟨prop_em True, prop_em False⟩

/-- Canary exercising `of_not_not` and `by_contra` on an arbitrary `Prop`. -/
theorem canary_not_not_by_contra (p : Prop) :
    (¬ ¬ p → p) ∧ ((¬ p → False) → p) :=
  ⟨of_not_not, by_contra⟩

/-- Canary exercising `imp_iff_not_or` and `not_and_iff_or_not`. -/
theorem canary_logic_bridges (p q : Prop) :
    ((p → q) ↔ (¬ p ∨ q)) ∧ (¬ (p ∧ q) ↔ (¬ p ∨ ¬ q)) :=
  ⟨imp_iff_not_or p q, not_and_iff_or_not p q⟩

/-- Canary exercising `chooseExists` on an inhabited positive `Nat` witness. -/
theorem canary_chooseExists_pos :
    0 < chooseExists (⟨1, Nat.zero_lt_succ 0⟩ : ∃ n : Nat, 0 < n) :=
  chooseExists_spec ⟨1, Nat.zero_lt_succ 0⟩

/-- Canary refuting an unsatisfiable existential via `chooseExists`. -/
theorem canary_chooseExists_false_rejected : ¬ ∃ n : Nat, n < n :=
  fun h => Nat.lt_irrefl (chooseExists h) (chooseExists_spec h)

end Anneal.ClassicalEm

/-!
# Shared Foundation-Locked `Init` Lemmas (`Anneal.InitLemmas`)

Pass-1-portable (`prelude` + locked `Init.*` only, zero `._unsafe_rec`,
admitted theory tactics only) lemma pack consolidating five high-frequency
helper clusters across `anneal/theory/` and `anneal/correspondence/`:

1. `Bool` connectives and `ite`/`dite` branch reduction from propositional
   hypotheses.
2. Generic `BEq` reflection bridges (`beq_refl` / `eq_of_beq` <-> `beq_iff`)
   plus `natListBeq`.
3. `Nat` power-of-two, division, and modulo identities.
4. Constructive `IntBalance` sign-magnitude `Nat` bridge for `Int` reasoning
   without `omega`.
5. Total `@Nat.rec` list indexing, slicing, and range-replacement lemmas.
-/

namespace Anneal.InitLemmas

/-! ## 1. `Bool` Connectives and `ite` / `dite` Eliminators -/

theorem bool_and_left {a b : Bool} (h : (a && b) = true) : a = true := by
  cases a with
  | false => cases b <;> nomatch h
  | true => rfl

theorem bool_and_right {a b : Bool} (h : (a && b) = true) : b = true := by
  cases a with
  | false => cases b <;> nomatch h
  | true => exact h

theorem bool_and_iff (a b : Bool) :
    (a && b) = true ↔ (a = true ∧ b = true) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨bool_and_left h, bool_and_right h⟩
  · intro h
    rw [h.1, h.2]
    rfl

theorem bool_or_eq_false {a b : Bool} (h : (a || b) = false) :
    a = false ∧ b = false := by
  cases a with
  | false => exact ⟨rfl, h⟩
  | true => nomatch h

theorem bool_not_true_eq_false {b : Bool} (h : (!b) = true) : b = false := by
  cases b with
  | false => rfl
  | true => nomatch h

theorem bool_not_false_eq_true {b : Bool} (h : (!b) = false) : b = true := by
  cases b with
  | false => nomatch h
  | true => rfl

theorem ite_true_of {α : Type u} {c : Prop} [d : Decidable c] {a b : α}
    (h : c) : (if c then a else b) = a := by
  cases d with
  | isTrue _ => rfl
  | isFalse hn => exact absurd h hn

theorem ite_false_of {α : Type u} {c : Prop} [d : Decidable c] {a b : α}
    (h : ¬ c) : (if c then a else b) = b := by
  cases d with
  | isTrue hp => exact absurd hp h
  | isFalse _ => rfl

theorem dite_true_of {α : Type u} {c : Prop} [d : Decidable c]
    {t : c → α} {e : ¬ c → α} (h : c) :
    (if hc : c then t hc else e hc) = t h := by
  cases d with
  | isTrue _ => rfl
  | isFalse hn => exact absurd h hn

theorem dite_false_of {α : Type u} {c : Prop} [d : Decidable c]
    {t : c → α} {e : ¬ c → α} (h : ¬ c) :
    (if hc : c then t hc else e hc) = e h := by
  cases d with
  | isTrue hp => exact absurd hp h
  | isFalse _ => rfl

/-! ## 2. Generic `BEq` Bridges and `Nat` / `List Nat` Equality Reflection -/

theorem beq_refl_of_iff {α : Type u} (beqFn : α → α → Bool)
    (hIff : ∀ a b : α, beqFn a b = true ↔ a = b) (x : α) :
    beqFn x x = true :=
  (hIff x x).2 rfl

theorem eq_of_beq_of_iff {α : Type u} (beqFn : α → α → Bool)
    (hIff : ∀ a b : α, beqFn a b = true ↔ a = b) {x y : α}
    (h : beqFn x y = true) : x = y :=
  (hIff x y).1 h

theorem beq_iff_of_refl_and_eq {α : Type u} (beqFn : α → α → Bool)
    (hRefl : ∀ x : α, beqFn x x = true)
    (hEq : ∀ {x y : α}, beqFn x y = true → x = y) (a b : α) :
    beqFn a b = true ↔ a = b := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact hEq h
  · intro h
    rw [h]
    exact hRefl b

theorem nat_beq_refl : ∀ n : Nat, Nat.beq n n = true
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 => nat_beq_refl n

theorem nat_eq_of_beq {a b : Nat} (h : Nat.beq a b = true) : a = b :=
  Nat.eq_of_beq_eq_true h

theorem nat_beq_iff (a b : Nat) : Nat.beq a b = true ↔ a = b :=
  beq_iff_of_refl_and_eq Nat.beq nat_beq_refl (fun h => nat_eq_of_beq h) a b

/-- Structural Boolean equality on `List Nat` defined via `List.foldr`. -/
@[expose] def natListBeq (xs ys : List Nat) : Bool :=
  List.foldr
    (fun (x : Nat) (ih : List Nat → Bool) (ys' : List Nat) =>
      match ys' with
      | [] => false
      | y :: rest => Nat.beq x y && ih rest)
    (fun ys' => match ys' with | [] => true | _ :: _ => false)
    xs ys

theorem natListBeq_cons_cons (x y : Nat) (xs ys : List Nat) :
    natListBeq (x :: xs) (y :: ys) = (Nat.beq x y && natListBeq xs ys) := rfl

theorem natListBeq_refl : ∀ xs : List Nat, natListBeq xs xs = true
  | [] => rfl
  | x :: xs => by
    rw [natListBeq_cons_cons, nat_beq_refl x, natListBeq_refl xs]
    rfl

theorem eq_of_natListBeq :
    ∀ {xs ys : List Nat}, natListBeq xs ys = true → xs = ys
  | [], [], _ => rfl
  | [], _ :: _, h => by nomatch h
  | _ :: _, [], h => by nomatch h
  | x :: xs, y :: ys, h => by
    rw [natListBeq_cons_cons] at h
    have hx : x = y := nat_eq_of_beq (bool_and_left h)
    have hxs : xs = ys := eq_of_natListBeq (bool_and_right h)
    rw [hx, hxs]

theorem natListBeq_iff (xs ys : List Nat) :
    natListBeq xs ys = true ↔ xs = ys :=
  beq_iff_of_refl_and_eq natListBeq natListBeq_refl
    (fun h => eq_of_natListBeq h) xs ys

/-! ## 3. `Nat` Power, Division, and Modulo Lemmas -/

theorem add_four_rearrange (a b c d : Nat) :
    (a + b) + (c + d) = (a + c) + (b + d) := by
  rw [Nat.add_assoc a b (c + d), ← Nat.add_assoc b c d, Nat.add_comm b c,
      Nat.add_assoc c b d, ← Nat.add_assoc a c (b + d)]

theorem nat_pow_zero (b : Nat) : Nat.pow b 0 = 1 := rfl

theorem nat_pow_succ (b n : Nat) : Nat.pow b (n + 1) = Nat.pow b n * b :=
  Nat.pow_succ b n

theorem nat_pow_add (b m : Nat) :
    ∀ n : Nat, Nat.pow b (m + n) = Nat.pow b m * Nat.pow b n
  | 0 => by
    rw [Nat.add_zero, nat_pow_zero, Nat.mul_one]
  | n + 1 => by
    rw [Nat.add_succ, nat_pow_succ, nat_pow_succ, nat_pow_add b m n,
        Nat.mul_assoc]

theorem nat_two_pow_pos : ∀ n : Nat, 0 < Nat.pow 2 n
  | 0 => by decide
  | n + 1 => by
    rw [nat_pow_succ]
    have ih := nat_two_pow_pos n
    have hTwo : Nat.pow 2 n * 2 = Nat.pow 2 n + Nat.pow 2 n :=
      Nat.mul_two (Nat.pow 2 n)
    rw [hTwo]
    exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le ih (Nat.le_add_right (Nat.pow 2 n) (Nat.pow 2 n))

theorem nat_div_add_mod (m k : Nat) :
    k * Nat.div m k + Nat.mod m k = m :=
  Nat.div_add_mod m k

theorem nat_mod_eq_of_lt {a b : Nat} (h : a < b) : Nat.mod a b = a :=
  Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h

theorem div2_mod2_inj (m n : Nat)
    (hDiv : Nat.div n 2 = Nat.div m 2)
    (hMod : Nat.mod n 2 = Nat.mod m 2) : n = m := by
  have hm : 2 * Nat.div m 2 + Nat.mod m 2 = m := Nat.div_add_mod m 2
  have hn : 2 * Nat.div n 2 + Nat.mod n 2 = n := Nat.div_add_mod n 2
  rw [hDiv, hMod] at hn
  rw [← hn, hm]

/-! ## 4. Constructive `IntBalance` Sign-Magnitude `Nat` Bridge -/

/-- Nonnegative magnitude component of an `Int`. -/
@[expose] def intPos : Int → Nat
  | .ofNat n => n
  | .negSucc _ => 0

/-- Negative magnitude component of an `Int` (`0` for nonnegative `Int`). -/
@[expose] def intNeg : Int → Nat
  | .ofNat _ => 0
  | .negSucc m => m + 1

/-- `IntBalance x p n` represents `x = (p : Int) - (n : Int)` using pure `Nat`
addition (`intPos x + n = intNeg x + p`), avoiding `Int` ring tactics. -/
@[expose] def IntBalance (x : Int) (p n : Nat) : Prop :=
  intPos x + n = intNeg x + p

theorem intBalance_self (x : Int) : IntBalance x (intPos x) (intNeg x) :=
  Nat.add_comm (intPos x) (intNeg x)

theorem intBalance_ofNat (n : Nat) : IntBalance (Int.ofNat n) n 0 := by
  dsimp only [IntBalance, intPos, intNeg]
  rw [Nat.zero_add, Nat.add_zero]

theorem intBalance_subNatNat (p n : Nat) :
    IntBalance (Int.subNatNat p n) p n := by
  unfold Int.subNatNat
  cases hSub : n - p with
  | zero =>
    have hLe : n ≤ p := Nat.le_of_sub_eq_zero hSub
    dsimp only [IntBalance, intPos, intNeg]
    rw [Nat.zero_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hLe]
  | succ k =>
    have hLt : p < n := Nat.lt_of_sub_eq_succ hSub
    have hAdd : p + (k + 1) = n := by
      rw [← hSub]
      exact Nat.add_sub_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt hLt)
    dsimp only [IntBalance, intPos, intNeg]
    rw [Nat.zero_add, Nat.add_comm (k + 1) p]
    exact hAdd.symm

/-! ## 5. Total `@Nat.rec` List Indexing and Slice Helpers -/

/-- Total list element lookup returning `none` when `idx ≥ xs.length`. -/
@[expose] def listNth {α : Type u} (xs : List α) (idx : Nat) : Option α :=
  @Nat.rec (fun _ => List α → Option α)
    (fun cur => match cur with | [] => none | x :: _ => some x)
    (fun _ ih cur => match cur with | [] => none | _ :: rest => ih rest)
    idx xs

theorem listNth_zero {α : Type u} (xs : List α) :
    listNth xs 0 = match xs with | [] => none | x :: _ => some x := rfl

theorem listNth_succ {α : Type u} (xs : List α) (n : Nat) :
    listNth xs (n + 1) =
      match xs with | [] => none | _ :: rest => listNth rest n := rfl

theorem listNth_map {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (f : α → β) :
    ∀ (idx : Nat) (xs : List α),
      listNth (xs.map f) idx = (listNth xs idx).map f
  | 0, [] => rfl
  | 0, _ :: _ => rfl
  | _ + 1, [] => rfl
  | n + 1, _ :: rest => listNth_map f n rest

/-- Total functional list update leaving out-of-bounds indices unchanged. -/
@[expose] def listSet {α : Type u} (xs : List α) (idx : Nat) (val : α) : List α :=
  @Nat.rec (fun _ => List α → List α)
    (fun cur => match cur with | [] => [] | _ :: rest => val :: rest)
    (fun _ ih cur => match cur with | [] => [] | x :: rest => x :: ih rest)
    idx xs

theorem listSet_length {α : Type u} (val : α) :
    ∀ (idx : Nat) (xs : List α), (listSet xs idx val).length = xs.length
  | 0, [] => rfl
  | 0, _ :: _ => rfl
  | _ + 1, [] => rfl
  | n + 1, _ :: rest => congrArg Nat.succ (listSet_length val n rest)

theorem listNth_listSet_same {α : Type u} (val : α) :
    ∀ (idx : Nat) (xs : List α),
      idx < xs.length → listNth (listSet xs idx val) idx = some val
  | 0, [], h => by nomatch h
  | 0, _ :: _, _ => rfl
  | _ + 1, [], h => by nomatch h
  | n + 1, _ :: rest, h =>
    listNth_listSet_same val n rest (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ h)

theorem listNth_listSet_other {α : Type u} (val : α) :
    ∀ (idx q : Nat) (xs : List α),
      idx ≠ q → listNth (listSet xs idx val) q = listNth xs q
  | 0, 0, _, hNe => False.elim (hNe rfl)
  | 0, _ + 1, [], _ => rfl
  | 0, _ + 1, _ :: _, _ => rfl
  | _ + 1, 0, [], _ => rfl
  | _ + 1, 0, _ :: _, _ => rfl
  | _ + 1, _ + 1, [], _ => rfl
  | n + 1, m + 1, _ :: rest, hNe =>
    listNth_listSet_other val n m rest (fun h => hNe (congrArg Nat.succ h))

/-- Total list prefix take defined via `@Nat.rec` (no `._unsafe_rec`). -/
@[expose] def listTake {α : Type u} (n : Nat) (xs : List α) : List α :=
  @Nat.rec (fun _ => List α → List α)
    (fun _ => [])
    (fun _ ih cur => match cur with | [] => [] | x :: rest => x :: ih rest)
    n xs

/-- Total list prefix drop defined via `@Nat.rec` (no `._unsafe_rec`). -/
@[expose] def listDrop {α : Type u} (n : Nat) (xs : List α) : List α :=
  @Nat.rec (fun _ => List α → List α)
    (fun cur => cur)
    (fun _ ih cur => match cur with | [] => [] | _ :: rest => ih rest)
    n xs

theorem listTake_append_listDrop {α : Type u} :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (xs : List α), listTake n xs ++ listDrop n xs = xs
  | 0, _ => rfl
  | _ + 1, [] => rfl
  | n + 1, x :: rest =>
    congrArg (List.cons x) (listTake_append_listDrop n rest)

/-- Total byte/element slice replacement `xs[off .. off + patch.length] :=
patch`, preserving length when `off + patch.length <= xs.length`. -/
@[expose] def replaceSlice {α : Type u} (xs : List α) (off : Nat) (patch : List α) :
    List α :=
  listTake off xs ++ patch ++ listDrop (off + patch.length) xs

theorem listTake_length_of_le {α : Type u} :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (xs : List α), n ≤ xs.length → (listTake n xs).length = n
  | 0, _, _ => rfl
  | _ + 1, [], h => by nomatch h
  | n + 1, _ :: rest, h =>
    congrArg Nat.succ (listTake_length_of_le n rest (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ h))

theorem listDrop_nil {α : Type u} :
    ∀ n : Nat, listDrop n ([] : List α) = []
  | 0 => rfl
  | _ + 1 => rfl

theorem listDrop_succ_cons {α : Type u} (n : Nat) (x : α) (rest : List α) :
    listDrop (n + 1) (x :: rest) = listDrop n rest := rfl

theorem listDrop_length {α : Type u} :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (xs : List α), (listDrop n xs).length = xs.length - n
  | 0, xs => (Nat.sub_zero xs.length).symm
  | n + 1, [] => by
    rw [listDrop_nil (n + 1)]
    dsimp only [List.length]
    exact (Nat.zero_sub (n + 1)).symm
  | n + 1, x :: rest => by
    rw [listDrop_succ_cons n x rest, listDrop_length n rest]
    dsimp only [List.length]
    exact (Nat.succ_sub_succ_eq_sub rest.length n).symm

theorem replaceSlice_length {α : Type u} (xs : List α) (off : Nat)
    (patch : List α) (hBound : off + patch.length ≤ xs.length) :
    (replaceSlice xs off patch).length = xs.length := by
  dsimp only [replaceSlice]
  rw [List.length_append, List.length_append]
  have hOffLe : off ≤ xs.length :=
    Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_right off patch.length) hBound
  rw [listTake_length_of_le off xs hOffLe, listDrop_length]
  exact Nat.add_sub_of_le hBound

/-! ## 6. Kernel-Checked Edge-Case Canaries -/

/-- Canary exercising Section 1 `Bool` and `ite`/`dite` branch lemmas. -/
theorem canary_bool_ite_edge :
    ((true && false) = false) ∧
    (false = false ∧ false = false) ∧
    (if false then (1 : Nat) else 2) = 2 ∧
    (if _ : (0 : Nat) < 1 then (3 : Nat) else 4) = 3 :=
  ⟨rfl, bool_or_eq_false rfl, ite_false_of (by decide),
    dite_true_of (by decide)⟩

/-- Canary exercising Section 2 `BEq` and `natListBeq` edge cases
(empty lists, length mismatch, element mismatch, and reflexivity). -/
theorem canary_natListBeq_edge :
    natListBeq [] [] = true ∧
    natListBeq [] [0] = false ∧
    natListBeq [0] [] = false ∧
    natListBeq [1, 2] [1, 3] = false ∧
    (natListBeq [1, 2] [1, 2] = true ↔ [1, 2] = [1, 2]) :=
  ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, natListBeq_iff [1, 2] [1, 2]⟩

/-- Canary exercising Section 3 `Nat` power, division, and modulo lemmas
(including zero exponent and `div2_mod2_inj`). -/
theorem canary_nat_pow_div_mod_edge (n : Nat) :
    0 < Nat.pow 2 0 ∧
    Nat.pow 2 (2 + 3) = Nat.pow 2 2 * Nat.pow 2 3 ∧
    Nat.mod 0 1 = 0 ∧
    div2_mod2_inj n n rfl rfl = rfl :=
  ⟨nat_two_pow_pos 0, nat_pow_add 2 2 3, nat_mod_eq_of_lt (by decide), rfl⟩

/-- Canary exercising Section 4 `IntBalance` edge cases (`0`, negative,
and nonnegative results from `Int.subNatNat`). -/
theorem canary_intBalance_edge :
    IntBalance (Int.ofNat 0) 0 0 ∧
    IntBalance (Int.subNatNat 0 0) 0 0 ∧
    IntBalance (Int.subNatNat 3 5) 3 5 ∧
    IntBalance (Int.subNatNat 5 3) 5 3 :=
  ⟨intBalance_ofNat 0, intBalance_subNatNat 0 0,
    intBalance_subNatNat 3 5, intBalance_subNatNat 5 3⟩

/-- Canary exercising Section 5 `@Nat.rec` list operations on empty,
out-of-bounds, and in-bounds inputs. -/
theorem canary_list_ops_edge :
    listNth ([] : List Nat) 0 = none ∧
    listNth [10] 5 = none ∧
    listSet ([] : List Nat) 0 1 = [] ∧
    listSet [10, 20] 5 99 = [10, 20] ∧
    listTake 5 [10, 20] = [10, 20] ∧
    listDrop 5 [10, 20] = [] ∧
    replaceSlice ([] : List Nat) 0 [] = [] ∧
    replaceSlice [1, 2, 3, 4] 1 [8, 9] = [1, 8, 9, 4] ∧
    (replaceSlice [1, 2, 3, 4] 1 [8, 9]).length = 4 :=
  ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl,
    replaceSlice_length [1, 2, 3, 4] 1 [8, 9] (by decide)⟩

/-!
# Reusable 3-Axiom Byte-Order Serialization Library (`Anneal.LeBytes`)

Kernel-checked, width-parametric little-endian and big-endian byte
serialization over `BitVec` and `Nat`, built strictly on Anneal's 51-module
`foundation-lock.json` foundation (no `omega`, no `bv_decide`, no `Std.*`,
and zero `_unsafe_rec` auxiliaries).

Operations use `HDiv.hDiv`, `HMod.hMod`, and `HPow.hPow` directly so every
statement matches standard `/`, `%`, and `^` syntax under `rw` and `simp` in
downstream proofs while staying within `allowedTheorySyntaxKinds`.

1. **Core Definitions:** structural `@Nat.rec` `toLeBytesAux`, `toLeBytes`,
   `List.foldr`-based `fromLeBytes`, `fromLeBytesBv`, big-endian `toBeBytes`
   and `fromBeBytes`, and fixed-width `u16`/`u32`/`u64`/`u128` aliases.
2. **Length & Bounds:** exact output lengths and `< 2^(8 * bs.length)` range
   bounds for decoded integers.
3. **Round-Trip & Injectivity:** exact left/right inverses between `toLeBytes`
   and `fromLeBytes`, injectivity for little-endian, big-endian, and
   concatenated byte sequences, and zero-byte identities.
4. **Byte Indexing, Concatenation & Closed Forms:** `getElem?` / `GetElem`
   byte formulas, append decomposition, and explicit 2-, 4-, and 8-byte
   expansions for `u16`, `u32`, and `u64`.
-/

/-! ## Part 0: Foundation-Only `Nat`, `BitVec`, and `List` Helpers -/

private theorem nat_pow_zero (a : Nat) : HPow.hPow a 0 = 1 := rfl

private theorem nat_pow_succ (a n : Nat) :
    HPow.hPow a (n + 1) = HPow.hPow a n * a :=
  Nat.pow_succ a n

private theorem nat_pow_add (a m n : Nat) :
    HPow.hPow a (m + n) = HPow.hPow a m * HPow.hPow a n := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rw [Nat.add_zero, nat_pow_zero, Nat.mul_one]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Nat.add_succ, nat_pow_succ, nat_pow_succ, ih, Nat.mul_assoc]

private theorem nat_two_pow_eight : HPow.hPow (2 : Nat) 8 = 256 := rfl

private theorem nat_two_pow_succ_mul_eight (n : Nat) :
    HPow.hPow (2 : Nat) ((n + 1) * 8) = 256 * HPow.hPow (2 : Nat) (n * 8) := by
  rw [Nat.succ_mul, Nat.add_comm (n * 8) 8, nat_pow_add, nat_two_pow_eight]

private theorem nat_two_pow_mul_eight_succ (i : Nat) :
    HPow.hPow (2 : Nat) (8 * (i + 1)) = 256 * HPow.hPow (2 : Nat) (8 * i) := by
  rw [Nat.mul_succ, Nat.add_comm (8 * i) 8, nat_pow_add, nat_two_pow_eight]

private theorem nat_mod_mul_split_pos (v a b : Nat) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    HMod.hMod v (a * b) =
      HMod.hMod v a + a * HMod.hMod (HDiv.hDiv v a) b := by
  have hdiv_q : HDiv.hDiv v a = b * HDiv.hDiv (HDiv.hDiv v a) b +
      HMod.hMod (HDiv.hDiv v a) b :=
    Eq.symm (Nat.div_add_mod (HDiv.hDiv v a) b)
  have hv_split : v = HMod.hMod v a + a * HMod.hMod (HDiv.hDiv v a) b +
      (a * b) * HDiv.hDiv (HDiv.hDiv v a) b := by
    have h1 : v = a * HDiv.hDiv v a + HMod.hMod v a :=
      Eq.symm (Nat.div_add_mod v a)
    rw [hdiv_q, Nat.mul_add, ← Nat.mul_assoc] at h1
    rw [Nat.add_comm (a * b * HDiv.hDiv (HDiv.hDiv v a) b)
        (a * HMod.hMod (HDiv.hDiv v a) b),
      Nat.add_assoc,
      Nat.add_comm (a * b * HDiv.hDiv (HDiv.hDiv v a) b) (HMod.hMod v a),
      ← Nat.add_assoc,
      Nat.add_comm (a * HMod.hMod (HDiv.hDiv v a) b) (HMod.hMod v a)] at h1
    exact h1
  have hrem_lt :
      HMod.hMod v a + a * HMod.hMod (HDiv.hDiv v a) b < a * b := by
    have hma : HMod.hMod v a < a := Nat.mod_lt v ha
    have hmb : HMod.hMod (HDiv.hDiv v a) b < b := Nat.mod_lt (HDiv.hDiv v a) hb
    have h1 : HMod.hMod v a + a * HMod.hMod (HDiv.hDiv v a) b <
        a + a * HMod.hMod (HDiv.hDiv v a) b :=
      Nat.add_lt_add_right hma (a * HMod.hMod (HDiv.hDiv v a) b)
    have h2 : a + a * HMod.hMod (HDiv.hDiv v a) b =
        a * (HMod.hMod (HDiv.hDiv v a) b + 1) := by
      rw [Nat.mul_succ, Nat.add_comm]
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le h1 (Nat.mul_le_mul_left a hmb)
  have hmod := congrArg (fun z => HMod.hMod z (a * b)) hv_split
  rw [Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hrem_lt] at hmod
  exact hmod

private theorem nat_mod_mul_split (v a b : Nat) :
    HMod.hMod v (a * b) =
      HMod.hMod v a + a * HMod.hMod (HDiv.hDiv v a) b := by
  cases a with
  | zero =>
    rw [Nat.zero_mul, Nat.mod_zero, Nat.zero_mul, Nat.add_zero]
  | succ a' =>
    cases b with
    | zero =>
      rw [Nat.mul_zero, Nat.mod_zero, Nat.mod_zero, Nat.add_comm,
        Nat.div_add_mod]
    | succ b' =>
      exact nat_mod_mul_split_pos v (Nat.succ a') (Nat.succ b')
        (Nat.zero_lt_succ a') (Nat.zero_lt_succ b')

private theorem bv_eq_of_toNat_eq {w : Nat} {a b : BitVec w}
    (h : a.toNat = b.toNat) : a = b := by
  cases a with
  | ofFin fa =>
    cases b with
    | ofFin fb =>
      exact congrArg BitVec.ofFin (Fin.eq_of_val_eq h)

private theorem bv_toNat_ofNat (w n : Nat) :
    (BitVec.ofNat w n).toNat = HMod.hMod n (HPow.hPow (2 : Nat) w) :=
  rfl

private theorem list_length_reverseAux {α : Type} (xs acc : List α) :
    (List.reverseAux xs acc).length = xs.length + acc.length := by
  induction xs generalizing acc with
  | nil =>
    rw [List.reverseAux_nil, List.length_nil, Nat.zero_add]
  | cons a rest ih =>
    rw [List.reverseAux_cons, ih, List.length_cons, List.length_cons,
      Nat.succ_add, Nat.add_succ]

private theorem list_length_reverse {α : Type} (xs : List α) :
    xs.reverse.length = xs.length := by
  unfold List.reverse
  rw [list_length_reverseAux, List.length_nil, Nat.add_zero]

private theorem list_reverse_append {α : Type} (xs ys : List α) :
    (xs ++ ys).reverse = ys.reverse ++ xs.reverse := by
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
    rw [List.nil_append, List.reverse_nil, List.append_nil]
  | cons a rest ih =>
    rw [List.cons_append, List.reverse_cons, List.reverse_cons, ih,
      List.append_assoc]

private theorem list_reverse_reverse {α : Type} (xs : List α) :
    xs.reverse.reverse = xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
    rfl
  | cons a rest ih =>
    rw [List.reverse_cons, list_reverse_append, ih]
    rfl

private theorem list_append_inj_of_length_eq {α : Type} :
    ∀ {l₁ l₂ r₁ r₂ : List α},
      l₁.length = l₂.length → l₁ ++ r₁ = l₂ ++ r₂ → l₁ = l₂ ∧ r₁ = r₂ := by
  intro l₁
  induction l₁ with
  | nil =>
    intro l₂ r₁ r₂ hlen happ
    cases l₂ with
    | nil =>
      exact ⟨rfl, happ⟩
    | cons _ _ =>
      nomatch hlen
  | cons a rest ih =>
    intro l₂ r₁ r₂ hlen happ
    cases l₂ with
    | nil =>
      nomatch hlen
    | cons b rest₂ =>
      rw [List.cons_append, List.cons_append] at happ
      injection happ with hab htail
      have hlen' : rest.length = rest₂.length := Nat.succ.inj hlen
      have hrec := ih hlen' htail
      have hhead : a :: rest = b :: rest₂ := by
        rw [hab, hrec.1]
      exact ⟨hhead, hrec.2⟩

/-! ## Part 1: Core Definitions and Fixed-Width Aliases -/

/-- Produce `n` little-endian bytes from the low `n * 8` bits of `v`. Using
`@Nat.rec` avoids compiler `_unsafe_rec` auxiliaries while remaining
`rfl`-reducible on `0` and `n + 1`. -/
@[expose] def toLeBytesAux (n : Nat) (v : Nat) : List (BitVec 8) :=
  @Nat.rec (fun _ => Nat → List (BitVec 8))
    (fun _ => [])
    (fun _ ih k => BitVec.ofNat 8 k :: ih (HDiv.hDiv k 256))
    n v

/-- Base equation of `toLeBytesAux` at zero bytes. -/
@[simp] theorem toLeBytesAux_nil (v : Nat) : toLeBytesAux 0 v = [] := rfl

/-- Step equation of `toLeBytesAux` at `n + 1` bytes. -/
@[simp] theorem toLeBytesAux_succ (n v : Nat) :
    toLeBytesAux (n + 1) v =
      BitVec.ofNat 8 v :: toLeBytesAux n (HDiv.hDiv v 256) :=
  rfl

/-- Encode an `(n * 8)`-bit bitvector into `n` little-endian bytes. -/
@[expose] def toLeBytes (n : Nat) (x : BitVec (n * 8)) : List (BitVec 8) :=
  toLeBytesAux n x.toNat

/-- Decode a list of little-endian bytes into a natural number. Using
`List.foldr` avoids compiler `_unsafe_rec` auxiliaries while remaining
`rfl`-reducible on `[]` and `b :: rest`. -/
@[expose] def fromLeBytes (bs : List (BitVec 8)) : Nat :=
  bs.foldr (fun b acc => b.toNat + 256 * acc) 0

/-- Base equation of `fromLeBytes` on the empty byte list. -/
@[simp] theorem fromLeBytes_nil : fromLeBytes [] = 0 := rfl

/-- Step equation of `fromLeBytes` on a non-empty byte list. -/
@[simp] theorem fromLeBytes_cons (b : BitVec 8) (rest : List (BitVec 8)) :
    fromLeBytes (b :: rest) = b.toNat + 256 * fromLeBytes rest :=
  rfl

/-- Decode a list of little-endian bytes into a bitvector of width
`bs.length * 8`. -/
@[expose] def fromLeBytesBv (bs : List (BitVec 8)) : BitVec (bs.length * 8) :=
  BitVec.ofNat (bs.length * 8) (fromLeBytes bs)

/-- Encode an `(n * 8)`-bit bitvector into `n` big-endian bytes. -/
@[expose] def toBeBytes (n : Nat) (x : BitVec (n * 8)) : List (BitVec 8) :=
  (toLeBytes n x).reverse

/-- Decode a list of big-endian bytes into a natural number. -/
@[expose] def fromBeBytes (bs : List (BitVec 8)) : Nat :=
  fromLeBytes bs.reverse

/-- Encode a 16-bit bitvector into 2 little-endian bytes. -/
abbrev u16ToLeBytes (x : BitVec 16) : List (BitVec 8) :=
  toLeBytes 2 x

/-- Encode a 32-bit bitvector into 4 little-endian bytes. -/
abbrev u32ToLeBytes (x : BitVec 32) : List (BitVec 8) :=
  toLeBytes 4 x

/-- Encode a 64-bit bitvector into 8 little-endian bytes. -/
abbrev u64ToLeBytes (x : BitVec 64) : List (BitVec 8) :=
  toLeBytes 8 x

/-- Encode a 128-bit bitvector into 16 little-endian bytes. -/
abbrev u128ToLeBytes (x : BitVec 128) : List (BitVec 8) :=
  toLeBytes 16 x

/-- Decode little-endian bytes into a 16-bit bitvector (modulo `2^16`). -/
abbrev u16FromLeBytes (bs : List (BitVec 8)) : BitVec 16 :=
  BitVec.ofNat 16 (fromLeBytes bs)

/-- Decode little-endian bytes into a 32-bit bitvector (modulo `2^32`). -/
abbrev u32FromLeBytes (bs : List (BitVec 8)) : BitVec 32 :=
  BitVec.ofNat 32 (fromLeBytes bs)

/-- Decode little-endian bytes into a 64-bit bitvector (modulo `2^64`). -/
abbrev u64FromLeBytes (bs : List (BitVec 8)) : BitVec 64 :=
  BitVec.ofNat 64 (fromLeBytes bs)

/-- Decode little-endian bytes into a 128-bit bitvector (modulo `2^128`). -/
abbrev u128FromLeBytes (bs : List (BitVec 8)) : BitVec 128 :=
  BitVec.ofNat 128 (fromLeBytes bs)

/-! ## Part 2: Length and Range Bounds -/

/-- `toLeBytesAux n v` always produces exactly `n` bytes. -/
@[simp] theorem toLeBytesAux_length (n v : Nat) :
    (toLeBytesAux n v).length = n := by
  induction n generalizing v with
  | zero =>
    rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [toLeBytesAux_succ, List.length_cons, ih]

/-- `toLeBytes n x` always produces exactly `n` bytes. -/
@[simp] theorem toLeBytes_length (n : Nat) (x : BitVec (n * 8)) :
    (toLeBytes n x).length = n :=
  toLeBytesAux_length n x.toNat

/-- `toBeBytes n x` always produces exactly `n` bytes. -/
@[simp] theorem toBeBytes_length (n : Nat) (x : BitVec (n * 8)) :
    (toBeBytes n x).length = n := by
  unfold toBeBytes
  rw [list_length_reverse, toLeBytes_length]

/-- Every little-endian byte list decodes strictly below `2^(bs.length * 8)`.
-/
theorem fromLeBytes_lt (bs : List (BitVec 8)) :
    fromLeBytes bs < HPow.hPow (2 : Nat) (bs.length * 8) := by
  induction bs with
  | nil =>
    exact Nat.zero_lt_one
  | cons b rest ih =>
    rw [fromLeBytes_cons, List.length_cons, nat_two_pow_succ_mul_eight]
    have hb : b.toNat < 256 := b.isLt
    have h1 : b.toNat + 256 * fromLeBytes rest <
        256 + 256 * fromLeBytes rest :=
      Nat.add_lt_add_right hb (256 * fromLeBytes rest)
    have h2 : 256 + 256 * fromLeBytes rest = 256 * (fromLeBytes rest + 1) := by
      rw [Nat.mul_succ, Nat.add_comm]
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le h1 (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 256 ih)

/-- Every big-endian byte list decodes strictly below `2^(bs.length * 8)`. -/
theorem fromBeBytes_lt (bs : List (BitVec 8)) :
    fromBeBytes bs < HPow.hPow (2 : Nat) (bs.length * 8) := by
  unfold fromBeBytes
  have h := fromLeBytes_lt bs.reverse
  rw [list_length_reverse] at h
  exact h

/-- `fromLeBytesBv` preserves the exact natural value of `fromLeBytes`. -/
@[simp] theorem fromLeBytesBv_toNat (bs : List (BitVec 8)) :
    (fromLeBytesBv bs).toNat = fromLeBytes bs := by
  unfold fromLeBytesBv
  rw [bv_toNat_ofNat]
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (fromLeBytes_lt bs)

/-! ## Part 3: Round-Trip, Injectivity, and Zero-Byte Identities -/

/-- Decoding `toLeBytesAux n v` recovers `v mod 2^(n * 8)`. -/
@[simp] theorem fromLeBytes_toLeBytesAux (n v : Nat) :
    fromLeBytes (toLeBytesAux n v) =
      HMod.hMod v (HPow.hPow (2 : Nat) (n * 8)) := by
  induction n generalizing v with
  | zero =>
    rw [toLeBytesAux_nil, fromLeBytes_nil, Nat.zero_mul, nat_pow_zero,
      Nat.mod_one]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [toLeBytesAux_succ, fromLeBytes_cons, ih, bv_toNat_ofNat,
      nat_two_pow_eight, nat_two_pow_succ_mul_eight]
    exact Eq.symm (nat_mod_mul_split v 256 (HPow.hPow (2 : Nat) (n * 8)))

/-- Decoding `toLeBytes n x` recovers `x.toNat`. -/
@[simp] theorem fromLeBytes_toLeBytes (n : Nat) (x : BitVec (n * 8)) :
    fromLeBytes (toLeBytes n x) = x.toNat := by
  unfold toLeBytes
  rw [fromLeBytes_toLeBytesAux, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt x.isLt]

/-- Decoding `toBeBytes n x` in big-endian order recovers `x.toNat`. -/
@[simp] theorem fromBeBytes_toBeBytes (n : Nat) (x : BitVec (n * 8)) :
    fromBeBytes (toBeBytes n x) = x.toNat := by
  unfold fromBeBytes toBeBytes
  rw [list_reverse_reverse, fromLeBytes_toLeBytes]

/-- Re-encoding `fromLeBytes bs` at width `bs.length` recovers `bs`. -/
@[simp] theorem toLeBytesAux_fromLeBytes (bs : List (BitVec 8)) :
    toLeBytesAux bs.length (fromLeBytes bs) = bs := by
  induction bs with
  | nil =>
    rfl
  | cons b rest ih =>
    rw [List.length_cons, fromLeBytes_cons, toLeBytesAux_succ]
    have hhead : BitVec.ofNat 8 (b.toNat + 256 * fromLeBytes rest) = b := by
      apply bv_eq_of_toNat_eq
      rw [bv_toNat_ofNat, nat_two_pow_eight, Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left,
        Nat.mod_eq_of_lt b.isLt]
    have hdiv : HDiv.hDiv (b.toNat + 256 * fromLeBytes rest) 256 =
        fromLeBytes rest := by
      rw [Nat.add_mul_div_left _ _ (by decide : 0 < 256),
        Nat.div_eq_of_lt b.isLt, Nat.zero_add]
    rw [hhead, hdiv, ih]

/-- `toLeBytes n` is injective on `BitVec (n * 8)`. -/
theorem toLeBytes_injective {n : Nat} {a b : BitVec (n * 8)}
    (h : toLeBytes n a = toLeBytes n b) : a = b := by
  apply bv_eq_of_toNat_eq
  rw [← fromLeBytes_toLeBytes n a, ← fromLeBytes_toLeBytes n b, h]

/-- `toBeBytes n` is injective on `BitVec (n * 8)`. -/
theorem toBeBytes_injective {n : Nat} {a b : BitVec (n * 8)}
    (h : toBeBytes n a = toBeBytes n b) : a = b := by
  unfold toBeBytes at h
  have hrev := congrArg List.reverse h
  rw [list_reverse_reverse, list_reverse_reverse] at hrev
  exact toLeBytes_injective hrev

/-- `fromLeBytes` is injective among equal-length byte lists. -/
theorem fromLeBytes_injective {xs ys : List (BitVec 8)}
    (hlen : xs.length = ys.length) (h : fromLeBytes xs = fromLeBytes ys) :
    xs = ys := by
  rw [← toLeBytesAux_fromLeBytes xs, ← toLeBytesAux_fromLeBytes ys, hlen, h]

/-- `fromBeBytes` is injective among equal-length byte lists. -/
theorem fromBeBytes_injective {xs ys : List (BitVec 8)}
    (hlen : xs.length = ys.length) (h : fromBeBytes xs = fromBeBytes ys) :
    xs = ys := by
  unfold fromBeBytes at h
  have hlen_rev : xs.reverse.length = ys.reverse.length := by
    rw [list_length_reverse, list_length_reverse, hlen]
  have hrev := fromLeBytes_injective hlen_rev h
  have hrev2 := congrArg List.reverse hrev
  rw [list_reverse_reverse, list_reverse_reverse] at hrev2
  exact hrev2

/-- Round-trip identity for `u16FromLeBytes ∘ u16ToLeBytes`. -/
@[simp] theorem u16FromLeBytes_u16ToLeBytes (x : BitVec 16) :
    u16FromLeBytes (u16ToLeBytes x) = x := by
  apply bv_eq_of_toNat_eq
  rw [bv_toNat_ofNat, fromLeBytes_toLeBytes 2 x, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt x.isLt]

/-- Round-trip identity for `u32FromLeBytes ∘ u32ToLeBytes`. -/
@[simp] theorem u32FromLeBytes_u32ToLeBytes (x : BitVec 32) :
    u32FromLeBytes (u32ToLeBytes x) = x := by
  apply bv_eq_of_toNat_eq
  rw [bv_toNat_ofNat, fromLeBytes_toLeBytes 4 x, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt x.isLt]

/-- Round-trip identity for `u64FromLeBytes ∘ u64ToLeBytes`. -/
@[simp] theorem u64FromLeBytes_u64ToLeBytes (x : BitVec 64) :
    u64FromLeBytes (u64ToLeBytes x) = x := by
  apply bv_eq_of_toNat_eq
  rw [bv_toNat_ofNat, fromLeBytes_toLeBytes 8 x, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt x.isLt]

/-- Round-trip identity for `u128FromLeBytes ∘ u128ToLeBytes`. -/
@[simp] theorem u128FromLeBytes_u128ToLeBytes (x : BitVec 128) :
    u128FromLeBytes (u128ToLeBytes x) = x := by
  apply bv_eq_of_toNat_eq
  rw [bv_toNat_ofNat, fromLeBytes_toLeBytes 16 x, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt x.isLt]

/-- Encoding zero produces `n` zero bytes. -/
@[simp] theorem toLeBytesAux_zero (n : Nat) :
    toLeBytesAux n 0 = List.replicate n (BitVec.ofNat 8 0) := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [toLeBytesAux_succ, List.replicate_succ, Nat.zero_div, ih]

/-- Decoding `n` zero bytes yields zero. -/
@[simp] theorem fromLeBytes_replicate_zero (n : Nat) :
    fromLeBytes (List.replicate n (BitVec.ofNat 8 0)) = 0 := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [List.replicate_succ, fromLeBytes_cons, ih, Nat.mul_zero, Nat.add_zero]
    rfl

/-! ## Part 4: Byte Indexing, Concatenation, and Closed Forms -/

/-- Optional lookup of the `i`-th little-endian byte of `toLeBytesAux n v`. -/
theorem toLeBytes_getElem? (n v i : Nat) (hi : i < n) :
    (toLeBytesAux n v)[i]? =
      some (BitVec.ofNat 8 (HDiv.hDiv v (HPow.hPow (2 : Nat) (8 * i)))) := by
  induction n generalizing v i with
  | zero =>
    exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero i hi)
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [toLeBytesAux_succ]
    cases i with
    | zero =>
      rw [Nat.mul_zero, nat_pow_zero, Nat.div_one]
      rfl
    | succ i =>
      have hstep :
          (BitVec.ofNat 8 v :: toLeBytesAux n (HDiv.hDiv v 256))[i + 1]? =
            (toLeBytesAux n (HDiv.hDiv v 256))[i]? :=
        rfl
      rw [hstep, ih (HDiv.hDiv v 256) i (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hi),
        Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul, ← nat_two_pow_mul_eight_succ]

/-- Direct indexed lookup of the `i`-th little-endian byte of `toLeBytes n x`
(definitionally equal to `(toLeBytes n x)[i]'hi`). -/
theorem toLeBytes_getElem (n : Nat) (x : BitVec (n * 8)) (i : Nat)
    (hi : i < (toLeBytes n x).length) :
    GetElem.getElem (toLeBytes n x) i hi =
      BitVec.ofNat 8 (HDiv.hDiv x.toNat (HPow.hPow (2 : Nat) (8 * i))) := by
  have hi' : i < n := by
    rw [toLeBytes_length] at hi
    exact hi
  have hopt : (toLeBytes n x)[i]? =
      some (BitVec.ofNat 8
        (HDiv.hDiv x.toNat (HPow.hPow (2 : Nat) (8 * i)))) :=
    toLeBytes_getElem? n x.toNat i hi'
  have hdef :
      (toLeBytes n x)[i]? = some (GetElem.getElem (toLeBytes n x) i hi) :=
    getElem?_pos (toLeBytes n x) i hi
  rw [hdef] at hopt
  injection hopt

/-- Little-endian decoding distributes over list concatenation with a
`2^(xs.length * 8)` radix shift. -/
theorem fromLeBytes_append (xs ys : List (BitVec 8)) :
    fromLeBytes (xs ++ ys) =
      fromLeBytes xs + HPow.hPow (2 : Nat) (xs.length * 8) * fromLeBytes ys := by
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
    rw [List.nil_append, fromLeBytes_nil, List.length_nil, Nat.zero_mul,
      nat_pow_zero, Nat.one_mul, Nat.zero_add]
  | cons b rest ih =>
    rw [List.cons_append, fromLeBytes_cons, fromLeBytes_cons, List.length_cons,
      ih, Nat.mul_add, ← Nat.add_assoc, ← Nat.mul_assoc,
      ← nat_two_pow_succ_mul_eight]

/-- Splitting `toLeBytesAux (m + n) v` into its low `m` bytes and high `n`
bytes. -/
theorem toLeBytesAux_add (m n v : Nat) :
    toLeBytesAux (m + n) v =
      toLeBytesAux m v ++
        toLeBytesAux n (HDiv.hDiv v (HPow.hPow (2 : Nat) (m * 8))) := by
  induction m generalizing v with
  | zero =>
    rw [Nat.zero_add, toLeBytesAux_nil, List.nil_append, Nat.zero_mul,
      nat_pow_zero, Nat.div_one]
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [Nat.succ_add, toLeBytesAux_succ, toLeBytesAux_succ, List.cons_append,
      ih (HDiv.hDiv v 256), Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul,
      ← nat_two_pow_succ_mul_eight]

/-- Concatenation of two fixed-width little-endian encodings is jointly
injective. -/
theorem toLeBytes_append_injective {m n : Nat}
    {a₁ a₂ : BitVec (m * 8)} {b₁ b₂ : BitVec (n * 8)}
    (h : toLeBytes m a₁ ++ toLeBytes n b₁ = toLeBytes m a₂ ++ toLeBytes n b₂) :
    a₁ = a₂ ∧ b₁ = b₂ := by
  have hlen : (toLeBytes m a₁).length = (toLeBytes m a₂).length := by
    rw [toLeBytes_length, toLeBytes_length]
  have hsplit := list_append_inj_of_length_eq hlen h
  exact ⟨toLeBytes_injective hsplit.1, toLeBytes_injective hsplit.2⟩

/-- Explicit 2-byte little-endian expansion for `BitVec 16`. -/
theorem toLeBytes_u16_eq (x : BitVec 16) :
    u16ToLeBytes x =
      [ BitVec.ofNat 8 x.toNat,
        BitVec.ofNat 8 (HDiv.hDiv x.toNat (HPow.hPow (2 : Nat) 8)) ] :=
  rfl

/-- Explicit 4-byte little-endian expansion for `BitVec 32`. -/
theorem toLeBytes_u32_eq (x : BitVec 32) :
    u32ToLeBytes x =
      [ BitVec.ofNat 8 x.toNat,
        BitVec.ofNat 8 (HDiv.hDiv x.toNat (HPow.hPow (2 : Nat) 8)),
        BitVec.ofNat 8 (HDiv.hDiv x.toNat (HPow.hPow (2 : Nat) 16)),
        BitVec.ofNat 8 (HDiv.hDiv x.toNat (HPow.hPow (2 : Nat) 24)) ] := by
  unfold u32ToLeBytes toLeBytes
  rw [toLeBytesAux_succ, toLeBytesAux_succ, toLeBytesAux_succ,
    toLeBytesAux_succ, toLeBytesAux_nil]
  repeat rw [Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul]

/-- Explicit 8-byte little-endian expansion for `BitVec 64`. -/
theorem toLeBytes_u64_eq (x : BitVec 64) :
    u64ToLeBytes x =
      [ BitVec.ofNat 8 x.toNat,
        BitVec.ofNat 8 (HDiv.hDiv x.toNat (HPow.hPow (2 : Nat) 8)),
        BitVec.ofNat 8 (HDiv.hDiv x.toNat (HPow.hPow (2 : Nat) 16)),
        BitVec.ofNat 8 (HDiv.hDiv x.toNat (HPow.hPow (2 : Nat) 24)),
        BitVec.ofNat 8 (HDiv.hDiv x.toNat (HPow.hPow (2 : Nat) 32)),
        BitVec.ofNat 8 (HDiv.hDiv x.toNat (HPow.hPow (2 : Nat) 40)),
        BitVec.ofNat 8 (HDiv.hDiv x.toNat (HPow.hPow (2 : Nat) 48)),
        BitVec.ofNat 8 (HDiv.hDiv x.toNat (HPow.hPow (2 : Nat) 56)) ] := by
  unfold u64ToLeBytes toLeBytes
  rw [toLeBytesAux_succ, toLeBytesAux_succ, toLeBytesAux_succ,
    toLeBytesAux_succ, toLeBytesAux_succ, toLeBytesAux_succ,
    toLeBytesAux_succ, toLeBytesAux_succ, toLeBytesAux_nil]
  repeat rw [Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul]

end Anneal.LeBytes
